history.summary: Plan completed and committed (5c485b0): task shape pre-settled, five phases — P1 staged secret_id proven before install, P2 per-call wrapper failures, P3 check-mode restart announcements, P4 kubelite readiness wait (all ansible), P5 lapsed-leaf runbook (root) — with 16 verification criteria covering R1-R6 1:1, R3 carried by slice 023. Dry-run parses clean; one out-of-scope observation filed as close-out S1.

Two findings need a ruling: P1's fail-closed check would stop an OpenBao whole-cluster recovery converge after srvvault1, and the two microceph restarts can never be announced under --check because the tasks that trigger them skip in check mode; P1 also assumes proving a secret_id needs an admin token, which would make its own rotation remedy fail at srvvault2.
